Single-player remains available as a guest.

en:
Your account has been deleted from the server.

it:
Per giocare contro altri giocatori serve un account.

Stai giocando come ospite: puoi accedere in qualsiasi momento da Impostazioni → Accedi, con Google oppure con email e password.

Da ospite restano disponibili le partite contro il computer.
en:
You need an account to play against other players.

You are playing as a guest: you can log in at any time from Settings → Log in, with Google or with email and password.

As a guest, matches against the computer remain available.
